Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

agentNames.description: Whether the service serves agent-name redirects. A client cannot detect it otherwise: with the feature off a name answers exactly as an unknown one.

domainPurgeGraceSeconds.description: How long a disabled domain keeps serving before its content becomes eligible for purge. Absent when the service cannot state it.

selfRegistration.description: The domains that admit parties with no account, and on what terms. Absent or empty: the service admits none, and did-management/account/register is refused everywhere.

serviceDid.description: The service's own DID: the recipient a client addresses every other Trust Task to, and the issuer of this response.

serviceNames.description: The agent names the service's own DID serves, as local parts. The community name of a service that owns its domain is the empty string. Empty when it serves none.

SelfRegistration.description: How one hosting domain admits parties with no account (did-management/account/register).

admissions.description: The admission evidence the domain accepts: `invite`, an invite from did-management/account/invite/issue; `voucher`, a voucher from one of `trustedVoucherIssuers`.

graceDays.description: How many days a disabled account is kept, and can be restored by renewal, before it is purged. Present exactly when `inactivityDays` is.

inactivityDays.description: How many days a self-registered account may go without a liveness signal before its DIDs are disabled. Absent: accounts on this domain do not expire.

maxDidCount.description: The most DIDs a self-registered account may hold. Absent: the service's ordinary per-account limit applies, which this task does not state.

maxTotalSizeBytes.description: The most bytes of DID content a self-registered account may hold. Absent when the service does not state one.

pathPrefixes.description: A self-registered DID's path (the `/`-separated `path` of did-management/account/register, not the DID's `:`-separated form) must sit under one of these, matched on whole segments: `g` admits `g/agent-1` but not `gx/agent-1` or `g` itself. Absent or empty: any path the domain's grammar admits. A registrant reads this before minting, because the path is fixed into the DID's identifier.

trustedVoucherIssuers.description: The DIDs of the trust communities whose vouchers the domain accepts. Present exactly when `admissions` includes `voucher`.
